Phase-3.name: Scale and agent workflows
Phase-3.description: Wave 3: single-gate CI, traceability, impact analysis, agent next-step guidance, incremental lint, sharded indexes for 200+ modules and monorepo project discovery. All steps are implemented, dogfooded on this repository and covered by tests.

step-1.description: mygrace ci: one read-only gate running strict lint + status + verification coverage, with optional trust-gated tests (landed early).

step-2.description: mygrace trace: requirement → module → verification → test → command → phases → dependents traceability with coded gaps.

step-3.description: mygrace impact: git diff/--files → direct modules → transitive dependents → verification blast radius → suggested commands.

step-4.description: mygrace next: deterministic nine-code next-step ladder driven by the same gates CI uses.

step-5.description: mygrace module shard: sharded indexes beyond the root index cap (ADR-6), transparent union reads, idempotent generator.

step-6.description: mygrace projects: bounded monorepo discovery with per-project counts, lint and coverage.

step-7.description: mygrace lint --changed: incremental scope from git diff/--files (index → full checks, entity → that entity, source → markup only).

step-8.description: MCP tools for ci/trace/impact/next/projects: catalog grew to 21 tools with one shared schema source.

outcome.item-1: One command (`mygrace ci`) is the only gate a release needs; it is implemented and dogfooded here.
outcome.item-2: An agent can ask what to do next, what changed and what a change impacts without re-reading the repository.
outcome.item-3: A 200-module synthetic project keeps lint under 2 s with indexes below their caps via sharding.
outcome.item-4: MCP exposes the same capabilities as the CLI with one catalog and no drift (21 tools).

deliverables.item-1: mygrace ci (landed): strict lint, status, coverage and optional tests in one envelope.
deliverables.item-2: mygrace trace (landed): requirement → module → verification → test traceability report with stable gap codes.
deliverables.item-3: mygrace impact (landed): changed files → affected modules, dependents, phases and proving commands.
deliverables.item-4: mygrace next (landed): deterministic next actionable step for an agent.
deliverables.item-5: mygrace module shard (landed): transparent sharded indexes with root index references.
deliverables.item-6: mygrace projects (landed): monorepo sub-project discovery with per-project health.
deliverables.item-7: mygrace lint --changed (landed): incremental lint scope for fast local/CI runs.

acceptance-gates.item-1: Synthetic 200-module project: mygrace ci runs in under 2 s and indexes stay under caps; the 150-module/3-shard fixture proves the sharded path.
acceptance-gates.item-2: Traceability test: every requirement maps to at least one module and verification entry; trace reports gaps with stable codes and honest exit codes.
acceptance-gates.item-3: Impact test: a changed file maps to the owning module and its transitive dependents; it degrades gracefully without git.
acceptance-gates.item-4: New commands and MCP tools keep the ADR-3 exit-code and ADR-8 envelope contracts; the catalog is the single source for 21 tools.
acceptance-gates.item-5: On this repository `mygrace lint --path . --strict` and `mygrace ci --path .` pass on the 25-module graph added by this phase.

landed-early.item-1: M-CI and V-M-CI were implemented ahead of the rest of Wave 3 so every later step can use one gate.
landed-early.item-2: mygrace ci is read-only by default; project commands run only with --tests and a valid trust record or opt-in.
landed-early.item-3: The MCP catalogue exposes the full CLI surface: 21 tools after the Wave-3 additions (mygrace_ci, trace, impact, next, projects included).

risks.item-1: Sharding must stay transparent: single-index projects must not change behaviour.
risks.item-2: New commands must not fragment the ADR-3/ADR-8 output contract.
risks.item-3: Impact analysis must degrade gracefully outside a git checkout (no git metadata).
risks.item-4: Advice must stay deterministic: no heuristics or model calls in mygrace next.

dependencies.item-1: Phase-2 gate (dogfooding): this repository passes `mygrace lint --path . --strict` and `mygrace ci --path .`.
dependencies.item-2: ADR-6 sharding design from ROADMAP section 4 before module shard is implemented.
dependencies.item-3: Git metadata is optional: impact and lint --changed must degrade gracefully outside a checkout.
dependencies.item-4: The MCP catalog in grace-mcp-commands.ts is the single source for new tools.
